title: Build an interactive data explorer
prompt: Design a Shiny application with a validated selector, reactive filter and an output table/chart including empty/error states.
objective: Practice shiny inputs, outputs, reactivity with explicit acceptance criteria and a reproducible result.
expected_output: The snippet is not executable in the browser preview. Plan input validation, empty results, accessibility and privacy.
acceptance_criteria: The submission addresses the task and all required core concepts.
Expected behavior and an edge case are described and checked.
Input assumptions, missing-value handling and output shape are documented where relevant.
Code is readable, uses appropriate R constructs and avoids destructive/external side effects.
Any result derived from statistics includes assumptions and relevant limitations.
hints: Identify the input, output and key R concept: Shiny inputs, outputs, reactivity.
The snippet is not executable in the browser preview. Plan input validation, empty results, accessibility and privacy.

grading_method: Draft/static token check only. The current platform grader can check whether the submitted text contains these strings, but it cannot execute R or prove program correctness.
